translations.web: I have also spoken to the prophets, and I have multiplied visions; and by the ministry of the prophets I have used parables.
translations.bsb: I spoke through the prophets and multiplied their visions; I gave parables through the prophets.
translations.kjv: I have also spoken by the prophets, and I have multiplied visions, and used similitudes, by the ministry of the prophets.
